facts.statement: A promotion gave a free doggy or kitty outfit when a Dog or Cat priced at 400 Station Cash was bought.
facts.quote: give you a FREE doggy or kitty outfit when you buy a Dog or Cat priced at 400 Station Cash

facts.statement: The promotion ran from 12:01 AM Pacific on February 10, 2012 to 11:59 PM Pacific on February 14, 2012.
facts.quote: available starting at 12:01 AM Pacific on February 10, 2012, and ending at 11:59 PM Pacific on February 14, 2012

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (We love our Free Realms Players!)
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing a Valentine's 2012 promotion: buying a Dog or Cat priced at 400 Station Cash gave a free matching doggy or kitty outfit, with a per-pet list of which outfit came with which pet. The post is dated only as '6 months, 5 days ago' relative to the capture, so its exact posting date is unknown; the promo window is stated as February 10-14, 2012.
